2608.30234.title: CoLa-ICD: A Knowledge-Enhanced Framework for Long-Tail Automated Medical Coding
2608.30234.paper_summary: Automatic medical coding assigns ICD codes to clinical notes, but it remains challenging due to long documents, imbalanced label distributions, and diverse terms. These challenges are especially severe for rare codes, which have limited training instances and are easily confused with semantically similar labels. We introduce CoLa-ICD, a knowledge-enhanced framework for long-tail prediction. CoLa-ICD enriches ICD labels with external terms, models dependencies among related codes, and learns stronger alignment between label semantics and clinical evidence for long-tail prediction. Experiments show that CoLa-ICD improves long-tail prediction with larger gains in larger and sparser label spaces and achieves state-of-the-art performance in AUC, F1, and P@k. Our code is available at https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD.
2608.30234.paper_summary_zh: 自動醫療編碼將ICD代碼分配給臨床筆記，但由於長文檔、不平衡的標籤分佈和多樣的術語，這仍然是一個挑戰。這些挑戰對於稀有代碼尤其嚴重，因為它們的訓練實例有限，且容易與語義相似的標籤混淆。我們介紹CoLa-ICD，一個增強知識的長尾預測框架。CoLa-ICD通過外部術語豐富ICD標籤，建模相關代碼之間的依賴關係，並學習標籤語義與臨床證據之間更強的對齊，以進行長尾預測。實驗表明，CoLa-ICD在較大和較稀疏的標籤空間中改善了長尾預測，並在AUC、F1和P@k上達到了最先進的性能。我們的代碼可在https://github.com/youwillbethebest/Cola-ICD獲得。
